note.zh-TW: 攤銷遞延資產的加回列預設放在這裡（T12）；攤銷在損益表列營業外支出（設計說明見 T05）。
note.en: The add-back for amortisation of deferred assets goes here by default (T12); on the income statement the amortisation is shown under non-operating expenses (see the design note T05).

definition.zh-TW: 折舊以外、沒有付現的費用或損失的加回列，例如遞延資產的攤銷。這些項目減少了利潤卻沒有減少現金，所以要加回。
definition.en: The add-back line for non-cash expenses and losses other than depreciation, such as amortisation of deferred assets. They reduce profit without reducing cash, so they are added back.
